name: chdss
description: Christian's Handy Dandy Screen Share — low-latency LAN screen and audio sharing

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check public/webrtc.js && node --check public/host.js && node --check public/viewer.js

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: CHDSS captures system audio so it can be shared with viewers on your local network.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: CHDSS captures the screen or window you select so it can be shared with viewers on your local network.

author: Christian Kossmann
